title: 4-Bit Counter
description: Synchronous binary counter built with D flip-flops, logic gates, clock, and 16-channel analyzer.

title: Basic Logic Gates
description: Compare AND, OR, XOR, and NAND gates interactively with switches, lights, and Truth Table view.

title: 1-Bit Full Adder
description: Gate-level Full Adder using XOR, AND, and OR gates to compute Sum and Carry-Out.

title: 4-Bit Adder + Hex Display
description: Add two 4-bit DIP switch values with binary digit readout, Hex display, and Carry indicator.

title: 4-Bit JK Ripple Counter
description: Asynchronous 4-bit up-counter using JK flip-flops driving a Hex display, binary readout, and Scope.

title: 4:1 MUX & 2-to-4 Decoder
description: Data selection and one-hot decoding using a Multiplexer, Decoder, DIP switches, and LED Bar Graph.

title: 7408 Quad AND IC
description: Demonstrates powering a 7408 DIP chip (Pin 14 VCC, Pin 7 GND) and driving a polarity-aware LED.
